targeted_regression.method: All 15 fixed baseline coordinates and normals use exact saved-STEP line common; every roof, restored fixed-side-skirt, rear-vent and tail-vent target must contain material with thickness >=1.2 mm. The old V2 removal expectation is obsolete.

wall.method: Deterministic area samples on exported meshes; normal rays from matched mother-surface faces, >=1 mm from sharp vent/interface/part edges, Z > 4 mm. Main/body nominal 1.6 mm; side-cap nominal 1.8 mm. Functional structures and the lower base are excluded.
wall.limits: Finite samples of ordinary skin only; this is not a continuous/global minimum-thickness guarantee. Thick samples can cross an integral support. Physical printing remains untested.

method_limits: No physical print, force/friction/fatigue/elastic FEA. Five button strokes use 9 positions each, five installation paths 31 positions each. The wheel annulus conservatively covers every rotation; 3 explicit angles are additionally checked. PLA fit, switch travel and detent engagement require physical calibration. V0.9 lower base is intentionally rebuilt; no equality to historical base/sensor solids is asserted.
